questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: You miss out on social events, and they have guards at the doors Friday - sunday, so you can't visit your friends

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: They said it was not guaranteed because of Covid. That 1 years students would be accommodated first, so we thought there would be nothing left, and therefore chose to stay off campus. And if we had chosen to stay on campus, the building they put the international students in looked like a prison.

Additional comments:

questions.answer: Very easy, they nave introduction days to help you, and sends emails before going.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *

questions.answer: Not succesfull, they were not offered when I went or was only for all-year students.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Remember to look very well at what subjects you can take.
